name: DeepMind study: self-evolving agents forget more the more they adapt
title: DeepMind study: self-evolving agents forget more the more they adapt
summary: A Google DeepMind paper tests ReasoningBank, GEPA and Meta-Harness on four task streams that drift in topic, workflow or domain, built from BIRD, BFCL and ScienceWorld. Self-evolution raises scores on most streams, but more adaptation consistently brings more forgetting, and static benchmarks hide it, so builders should evaluate self-improving agents on changing streams.
